claims.assertion: Rashell says the Federation Council contacted Eisenhower by radio and chose her as envoy.

claims.assertion: At Edwards in 1954, Rashell offered free power for nuclear disarmament; Eisenhower rejected it, citing Russia.
claims.speaker: Rashell

claims.assertion: At their second meeting, Eisenhower accused her of being Vril; Rashell says this suspicion undermined talks.
claims.speaker: Rashell

claims.assertion: She says Maitré offered weapons technology for human and animal access, demanded bases for missing components; the US complied, ending diplomacy.
claims.speaker: Rashell

claims.assertion: Rashell says Taygetans sought to infiltrate Nazi Germany to impede its nuclear and flying-disc programs.
claims.speaker: Rashell
